# Week 6 — Visual QA log

**Source:** `docs/pptx/week-6-fullstack.pptx` (58 slides, regenerated by `scripts/build_pptx_week_6.py`)

## Method
1. `soffice --headless --convert-to pdf` → PDF
2. `pdftoppm -jpeg -r 100` → one JPEG per slide
3. Walked all 58 rendered pages; spot-checked the cover, two-column slides, agenda, arch / "back to deck" status slides, build-framing callouts, and close.

## Defects found and fixed in `scripts/build_pptx_week_6.py`
- **Cols-2 columns dropped their component chrome.** When a `<div class="card">`, `<div class="arch">`, `<div class="prompt">`, etc. was the immediate root of a column inside `cols-2`, the parser walked into the column's children instead of classifying the column itself, so the architecture diagram on slides 14, 18, 22, 27, 31, 35, 40, 44, 48 rendered as raw text and slide 3 lost its card backgrounds. **Fix:** factor a `classify(tag)` helper in `_extract_body_blocks` and call it on each column root before falling back to `walk`.
- **Cover H1 overflowed the gold rule.** `Full-Stack` / `AI-Assisted Development` wrapped to 3 visual lines at 64 pt; the gold rule and lede paragraph cut through the third line. **Fix:** estimate visual line count from text length vs. box width, auto-shrink the H1 (64 → 56 → 48 pt) until the title fits in two lines, then position the rule and lede from the resulting box height.
- **Pillrow grabbed half the body.** A pillrow stacked under a cols-2 (slide 3) was given `weight = 1.0` in `_render_col_blocks`, claiming ~50 % of the body region. **Fix:** treat pillrow as a fixed-height block (sized by row count) alongside `build_banner` and `arch_callout`, then distribute remaining height by weight.

Stale `if len(slides) != 57` check in `main()` updated to 58 to match the source HTML.

## Verified after fix
- Cover (slide 1): title fits cleanly on 2 lines, rule and lede sit below.
- Slide 3 ("How today runs"): both cards render with accent stripes; pillrow compact at the bottom.
- Slide 12 ("Five tools"): bullets + prompt callout side by side.
- Module-complete arch slides (14, 18, 22, 27, 48): full L1–L4 table renders with red `is-built` cells, gold `is-current` stripes, and per-layer descriptions.
- Closing / agenda slides (5, 50, 52, 55): unchanged — no regressions.

## Known minor cosmetic items (logged, not fixed in this pass)
- The "Student prompt" callout on slide 12 (and similar one-block right columns on slides 25, 38) leaves ~2" of empty interior because the prompt block is sized by column weight rather than content height. Tracked as a follow-up.

## How to re-run the QA
```sh
uv run python3 scripts/build_pptx_week_6.py
soffice --headless --convert-to pdf --outdir /tmp/qa-week6 docs/pptx/week-6-fullstack.pptx
pdftoppm -jpeg -r 100 /tmp/qa-week6/week-6-fullstack.pdf /tmp/qa-week6/slide
```
